# Wise Saturn

Wise Saturn designs an automatic self-cleaning water trough for Australian feedlot sheep operations and large commercial sheep farms.

## Primary product
- Automatic self-cleaning livestock water trough
- Approximate dimensions: 2000 mm long, 200 mm wide, 400 mm high
- Operational focus: sediment removal, water exchange, water saving, cooling support and reduced cleaning labour
- Installation: site assessment required

## Commercial programmes
- Supported three-month feedlot trial
- Dealer and distributor enquiries
